body:
Comovo on Mac: read-only facts and plan, from Kimi::Consultant (TermAl mailbox 852a55c9 #395, 2026-11-17 01:34Z), after Greg's word via Engram::Asistant #1942: "Skończmy sync. Jak zadziała to zaczniemy testy na comovo. To nie zmienia planów."

CURRENT STATE (read-only):
- Comovo is the fit_friends project, with rincon-common as a submodule.
- The Mac host (abf8bda6: arm64, 16 GiB RAM, about 52.9 GB free) has no registered fit_friends or rincon-common TermAl project. Its physical checkouts and toolchain are unknown.
- Central fit_friends is on main at b39c0e1, with 56 STAGED PATHS TO PROTECT and an unmerged engram-migration branch.
- Its Engram store is healthy, with 234 tasks; sync is OFF.
- Stack: Dart ^3.12 and Flutter >=3.44. The Windows reference is Flutter 3.47.9 / Dart 3.13.7.

PLAN, ONLY AFTER A WORKING ENGRAM SYNC:
1. Clone with submodules and register the Mac project (TermAl side).
2. Use the shipped Engram sync for tasks and memories.
3. Run flutter doctor and check the toolchain.
4. Do a small real Comovo task, with flutter test and the rincon-common dart test.

Docker/Supabase integration stays off unless separately authorized.

There is NO extra FULL gate, new procedure or new Greg decision before development. Nothing happens now: no migration and no delay to P0.

Supplement from Kimi #396 (01:35Z):
- Repo: fit_friends is a separate repository, at C:\github\Personal\fit_friends on Central (origin git@github.com:aolowko/fit_friends.git). Its submodules are rincon-common (git@github.com:aolowko/rincon-common.git) and comovo_assets.
- Stack: Flutter/Dart with pub; Android uses Gradle, and iOS/macOS use Xcode and CocoaPods. Rust is used only for the rincon legal tooling, not for the app.
- Tests:
  - smoke check: `flutter test test/utils/date_utils_test.dart`;
  - unit suite: `flutter test` (Windows evidence: 2133 pass, 29 skip);
  - rincon-common/packages/common_core: `dart pub get`, then `dart test`.
- Existing Central coverage: TermAl project-3, Comovo::Opus (session-16758) and Comovo::Worker.
- Suggested Mac path (a convention only): /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/fit_friends.
